tasks.statement_en: The number log_3(sqrt(27)) - log_27(sqrt(3)) is equal to: A. 4/3  B. 1/2  C. 11/12  D. 3. Choose the correct answer from the options given.

The function f is given by f(x) = (x^3-8)/(x-2) for every real x != 2. The value of the derivative of this function at the argument x=1/2 is equal to: A. 3/4  B. 9/4  C. 3  D. 54/8. Choose the correct answer from the options given.

tasks.topic_en: Sine of a difference of angles
tasks.statement_en: If cos(beta) = -1/3 and beta is in (pi, 3*pi/2), then the value of the expression sin(beta - pi/3) is equal to: A. (-2*sqrt(2)+sqrt(3))/6  B. (2*sqrt(6)+1)/6  C. (2*sqrt(2)+sqrt(3))/6  D. (1-2*sqrt(6))/6. Choose the correct answer from the options given.
tasks.notes: sin(beta)=-2*sqrt2/3 (third quadrant); expansion gives option A.

tasks.statement_en: There are two urns with balls, each containing seven balls. The first urn has 1 white ball and 6 black balls; the second urn has 4 white balls and 3 black balls. A fair coin is tossed once. If it comes up tails, a ball is drawn from the first urn; otherwise, a ball is drawn from the second urn. The probability of drawing a white ball in this experiment is equal to: A. 5/14  B. 9/14  C. 5/7  D. 6/7. Choose the correct answer from the options given.

The sequence (a_n) is defined for every natural number n>=1 by a_n = [(7p-1)n^3+5pn-3] / [(p+1)n^3+n^2+p], where p is a positive real number. Calculate the value of p for which the limit of the sequence (a_n) equals 4/3. (In the exam, the answer is coded as the first three digits after the decimal point of the infinite decimal expansion of p.)
tasks.notes: p=7/17=0.41176...; the exam's coded boxes hold digits 4,1,1, matching this value.
Prove 7x^3+4x^2y>=y^3+2xy^2-x^3 for all real x,y with 2x>y.
Only x=-8/3 works (the x>=3 case gives x=-14, rejected). [verified: ok: x>=3 gives x=-14 (rejected); x<3 gives 3-x=2x+11, x=-8/3 (check 17/3=17/3). Unique solution, matches key.]

tasks.topic_pl: Trapez i okręgi opisane na trójkątach
tasks.topic_en: Trapezoid and circumscribed circles of triangles

tasks.statement_en: The remainder from dividing the polynomial W(x) = 4x^3 - 6x^2 - (5m+1)x - 2m by the binomial x+2 is equal to -30. Calculate m, and for the value of m found, solve the inequality W(x) >= 0.
tasks.notes: Only m=3 is numeric; the inequality's solution set [-1,-1/2] u [3,+inf) is an interval, not summed.

tasks.summary_pl: Ciąg geom. $a_n$ i arytm. $b_n$ powiązane: oblicz $b_1$
tasks.statement_en: The sequence (a_n), defined for every natural number n>=1, is geometric with all terms positive. Also a_1=675 and a_22 = (5/4)a_23 + (1/5)a_21. The sequence (b_n), defined for every natural number n>=1, is arithmetic. The sum of all terms of the (infinite) sequence (a_n) equals the sum of the first twenty-five terms of the sequence (b_n). Also a_3 = b_4. Calculate b_1.
Solve the equation sin(x) + sin(2x) + sin(3x) = 0 in the interval [0, pi].
Find all values of the parameter m for which the equation x^2 - (m+1)x + m = 0 has two distinct real solutions x1 and x2, satisfying x1 != 0, x2 != 0, and 1/x1 + 1/x2 + 2 = 1/x1^2 + 1/x2^2.
tasks.notes: Vieta gives 2m^2+m-1=0 => m=-1 or m=1/2; both give distinct nonzero roots; sum=-0.5.

tasks.statement_en: A right prism ABCDEFGH has rectangular base ABCD. The face diagonals AH and AF form an acute angle of measure alpha, with sin(alpha)=12/13 (see figure). The area of triangle AFH is 26.4. Calculate the height h of this prism.

tasks.topic_en: Isosceles triangle in the coordinate plane
tasks.statement_en: Point A=(-3,2) is a vertex of isosceles triangle ABC, in which |AC|=|BC|. The area of this triangle is 15. Side BC lies on the line y=x-1. Calculate the coordinates of vertices B and C of this triangle.
tasks.notes: Four valid (B,C) pairs satisfy all conditions (all listed as fully correct in the official key): C=(4,3)&B=(-1,-2); C=(4,3)&B=(9,8); C=(-4,-5)&B=(1,0); C=(-4,-5)&B=(-9,-10). Value sums all coordinates across all four pairs: 4+24-8-28=-8. [verified: exclude: Key p.32 lists 4 (B,C) pairs. C repeats across pairs: summing per pair gives -8, summing distinct points gives -6, one pair gives 4/24/-8/-28. Several solution ]

tasks.summary_pl: Trójkąt równoram., obwód $18$: bok trójkąta o max. polu
tasks.summary_en: Isosceles triangle, perimeter $18$: side length at max area
tasks.statement_en: Consider all isosceles triangles with perimeter equal to 18. a) Show that the area P of each of these triangles, as a function of the leg length b, is given by P(b) = (18-2b)*sqrt(18b-81)/2. b) Find the domain of the function P. c) Calculate the side lengths of the triangle, among those considered, that has the largest area.
tasks.notes: Parts a) and b) are non-numeric (proof; domain (4.5,9)). Part c): P'(b)=0 at b=6, the triangle is equilateral with all sides 6; value=6 (one distinct side length, all three sides equal, not summed three times). [verified: exclude: Max area at b=6, a=6 (equilateral); key p.41 states a=6 i b=6. Side once (6), a+b (12) or all sides (18, trivially the perimeter) is a convention.]
